text_en: Each word grows heavier, each voice grows faint

text_zh:
残余异文：RA-047 · 递减回流
归属意志：第 ███ 层 · ████████
异常概述：影响区域内的铅字在连续铸印过程中重量逐步衰减。第 ██ 铸字坊的全部铅字在 ██ 小时内粉化，字盘表面检出未知腐蚀痕迹。键徒体检指标未见异常，铸印动作经影像确认无偏差。
收容残余：引擎压制下，异常表现为铭刻效率的递进式下降。持续时间受限于单次登塔周期。
附注：以双倍供给抵消蚀失的实验已终止。结果：蚀失速率反增 ██%。油壶内容物呈琥珀色，检测显示未发生化学变化。
——「有增必有减，此乃铅字之道。」
text_en:
Residual Anomaly: RA-047 · Diminishing Returns
Attributed Will: Layer ███ · ████████
Anomaly Overview: Leaden glyphs within affected areas exhibit progressive mass degradation during sustained inscription. All typesetting equipment in Workshop ██ disintegrated within ██ hours, leaving unknown corrosion patterns on letter beds. Personnel medical evaluations show no abnormalities; inscription motions confirmed accurate via surveillance.
Containment Residue: Under Engine suppression, anomaly manifests as progressive degradation of inscription efficiency. Duration limited to single ascent cycles.
Addendum: Experiments using doubled supply rates to counter degradation have been terminated. Result: degradation rate increased by ██%. Oil flask contents exhibit amber coloration despite no detected chemical changes.
——"What rises must fall; such is the way of lead."
